title: Kissed Light Peruvian Almond Suspiro Limeno
description: A light and energizing Peruvian dish featuring almond butter and a mirepoix base, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This suspiro limeno is a unique dessert that combines the flavors of Peru with the creaminess of almond butter.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the almond butter over low heat, stirring constantly, until it is lightly toasted and fragrant.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened.
Add the grated ginger, ground turmeric, and ground cinnamon to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the honey and evaporated milk to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot and creamy.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the saucepan and refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Just before serving, whip the mixture with a fork until it is light and airy.
Spoon the Kissed Light Peruvian Almond Suspiro Limeno into individual serving cups and serve chilled.
